title: Solar Flare Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Sun-shade Foliage
description:
Dramatic Foliage for Sun or Shade - A Summer Standout!
KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant red, lime, and yellow foliage for dramatic effect
• Thrives in both full sun and partial shade
• Vigorous, upright growth habit for height and structure
• Excellent for mixed containers, beds, and borders
• Low-maintenance and easy to grow
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides
Colour: Red, Yellow, Green foliage
Season: Late Spring, Summer, Late Summer (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Upright
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full Sun to Partial Shade
Soil: Well-drained with moderate organic content
Watering: Medium, keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged
Spacing: 41-51 cm (16-20 inches)
Height: 46-91 cm (18-36 inches)
Spread: 41-71 cm (16-28 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10-11 (typically annual in UK)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Upon arrival, unpack plugs immediately and stand in water for an hour before potting.
• Pot into 9cm pots using good multi-purpose compost; water well initially, then only when the top compost begins to dry.
• Pinch regularly to encourage a bushy habit and denser foliage, removing any emerging flower spikes.
• For overwintering, move plants indoors to a bright, indirect light location before first frost.
• Feed every two weeks with a high-potash fertiliser during the growing season for best results.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
